issues.detail: Threads TH2 (13 messages), TH3 (12 messages), TH4 (10 messages), and TH5 (10 messages) fall below the global minimum of 15 messages per thread. Additionally, all threads fail to meet the minimum of their specific target_messages_range defined in the blueprint.
Thread TH5 has an empty next_steps array in its thread_outcome. It must contain at least one item with a valid task_id and owner_id.
